name: RC-B10-0451/2025 – After § 12 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text: 12a. Is concerned about the transfer of Andrzej Poczobut, a Polish-Belarusian national who is active as a journalist, among other roles, and is a leading member of the Union of Poles in Belarus, from solitary confinement to a high-security cell in a Belarusian penal colony; calls for his immediate release;
